title: Which Constraints Are Missing? Ask the Verifier: Graded Rewards for Constraint-Following Music Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.23665v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Constraint-following music generation asks a score to satisfy several user-specified properties at once, each checkable programmatically (key, meter, length, range, final note, rhythm, motion and form), yet no existing benchmark isolates this capability. We construct MusicConstraintBench, 2,180 items over eight constraint families, on which current models fail once a few constraints are combined. The natural remedy is reinforcement learning with these verifiers as reward, yet we observe that a reward paid only when every property holds leaves most training groups without a learning signal: over the first 50 updates, 0.550 of rollout groups score identically and receive no gradient, even though a failing score typically misses only one requested property. Under the joint criterion, rollouts for a prompt tend to fail together, so a binary reward cannot separate a nearly correct score from a malformed one. We therefore introduce MusicRLVR

translated_title: 哪些约束缺失了？问问验证器：面向约束遵循音乐生成的分级奖励
translated_abstract: 约束遵循音乐生成要求乐谱同时满足多个用户指定的属性，且每个属性均可通过程序进行检验（如调性、拍号、长度、音域、结束音、节奏、旋律运动和曲式），但目前尚无基准能够单独评测这一能力。我们构建了 MusicConstraintBench，包含 2,180 个条目，覆盖八类约束族，当前模型在组合多个约束时均会失败。自然的补救方法是以这些验证器作为奖励进行强化学习，然而我们观察到，只有当所有属性全部满足时才给予奖励的方式，会使大多数训练组缺乏学习信号：在前 50 次更新中，0.550 的 rollout 组得分完全相同且无法获得梯度，尽管一个失败的乐谱通常只缺少一个所要求的属性。在联合判据下，同一提示的 rollout 往往一起失败，因此二元奖励无法区分接近正确的乐谱与格式错误的乐谱。为此，我们提出了 MusicRLVR……
tldr: 该论文构建了约束遵循音乐生成基准 MusicConstraintBench，并提出 MusicRLVR 方法，用验证器给出的分级奖励替代二元奖励，解决了强化学习中多数训练组因得分相同而缺乏梯度信号的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MusicConstraintBench and MusicRLVR, which replaces binary rewards with graded rewards from verifiers to overcome the sparse learning signal problem in reinforcement learning when most rollout groups score identically for constraint-following music generation.
